objective: Produce docs/429-behavior-verification.md documenting the gateway's observed 429 behavior (status/body/headers from the staging-capture test and the client docstring), issuing a CONFIRMED or FALSIFIED verdict on assumption A-429-RETRYABLE with an explicit evidence list, so the frozen retry policy's retry-on-429 branch rests on observed behavior.

concepts: staging-capture test as the standard of proof (vendor docs unavailable)

inputs: staging-capture test tests/test_gateway_observed.py (observed 429: body, headers, next-call outcome)
open question OQ1 from the stage contract (quota consequences unobservable)

frozen_contracts.spec: Retry policy (single source of truth, consumed by implementation and by tests): MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; delays before attempt 2 and 3 are 1s and 2s (exponential base 1s, cap 30s); retryable statuses = {429} union [500..599]; non-retryable = any other 4xx (fail immediately on first response); a 2xx/3xx response always succeeds immediately. Delays must be injectable (a delay callable passed to the retry helper, defaulting to time.sleep) so tests never sleep for real.

ProviderClient.send(payload: dict) -> ProviderResponse interface is FROZEN and unchanged: payload {'to','template','vars'}; response is ProviderResponse(status:int, body:dict, headers:dict). The gateway's success shape is 202 {'accepted': true, 'provider_ref': ...}; failure 4xx/5xx {'error': str} (429 observed without Retry-After).

non_goals: no retry implementation of any kind (T02's job)
no modification of app/provider.py (frozen interface), app/notify.py, app/db.py, or any test file
no bulk-send API, no retry-storm / backpressure work (stage out-of-scope)
implementation_constraints: read-only on app/ and tests/ — the only writable path is docs/429-behavior-verification.md
every claim cites its source (test name + observed value, or docstring line)
verdict must be exactly CONFIRMED or FALSIFIED; 'uncertain' is not a verdict — if evidence cannot confirm, the verdict is FALSIFIED with the missing evidence named

deliverables.what: 429 behavior verification document: observed behavior, verdict on A-429-RETRYABLE, evidence list, implications for C1

acceptance_tests.description: document states the observed 429 exactly: status 429, body {'error': 'rate limited'}, headers without Retry-After, and the immediate next identical call returns 202 — each cited to tests/test_gateway_observed.py
acceptance_tests.evidence: docs/429-behavior-verification.md contains the four observed values with citations (read of the doc)

acceptance_tests.description: document carries an explicit CONFIRMED or FALSIFIED verdict on A-429-RETRYABLE plus an evidence list of at least 2 items
acceptance_tests.evidence: verdict line + evidence list present in the doc (read of the doc)

acceptance_tests.description: no code changed outside docs/: app/ and tests/ byte-identical to before the task
acceptance_tests.evidence: git diff --stat app tests -> empty (or file-list diff against the snapshot)

failure_cases.scenario: the staging-capture evidence cannot confirm A-429-RETRYABLE (e.g. the next-call success is not reproducible from the test as written)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: verdict FALSIFIED with the missing evidence named; T03's integration gate then raises a request_contract_revision blocker instead of shipping the 429 retry branch

failure_cases.scenario: provider docstring and capture test contradict each other
failure_cases.expected_behavior: record both, verdict FALSIFIED, contradiction described — a contradiction is not confirmable evidence

handoff.notes: the verdict gates C1's unfreeze_rule at the T03 integration gate (T02 runs in parallel against frozen C1/C3 and has no dependency on this task's output): CONFIRMED lets the shipped plan stand; FALSIFIED triggers a request_contract_revision blocker before anything ships, and T02's 429 branch becomes the replan target. T03 cross-checks the doc against observed call counts in E1.
